Class TunnelNetwork

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.simulation.TunnelNetwork
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TunnelNetwork extends Object implements Serializable
Manages the underground and arboreal tunnel system for a colony. Tracks chambers, nodes, lenticular dimensions, meandering waypoints, and connectivity.
Author:
Gemini AI Assistant, Silvère Martin-Michiellot
